text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2020. December 16, 2020 Councillor Pasternak, during the morning session of the meeting, recognize first responders who have recently responded to a number of fires in York Centre. Councillor Pasternak remarked that in recent weeks there have been fires in the Stanley Greene neighbourhood, the Armour Gardens neighbourhood and at 6250 Bathurst Street, a Toronto Community Housing Corporation Building. Councillor Pasternak thanked first responders for their quick response in saving lives and protecting property, and thanked a number of agencies who came to the aid of residents affected by the fire.
